prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: production website hero plate, ultra-wide 2.22:1 landscape
Primary request: Recreate the authentic Shafi Complex & Marquee exterior from Image 1 as a clean high-resolution evening hero photograph matching Image 2’s framing and warm dusk treatment. Preserve the recognizable symmetrical facade, central entrance, circular blue-tiled fountain, forecourt geometry, rooflines, columns, and existing building signage. This is an enhancement of the real venue, not a redesign.
Scene/backdrop: the real Jaranwala venue forecourt at dusk, dark blue sky, warm architectural lighting, restrained fountain reflections.
Composition/framing: ultra-wide 2675×1205-equivalent, centered architectural axis, facade and fountain fully legible, image fills frame edge to edge.
Lighting/mood: believable premium evening photography, warm building light, deep natural shadows, locally grounded.
Constraints: remove every website UI overlay, headline, form, button, line, and navigation element; no people; do not add buildings, decorations, vehicles, structures, or event setups; retain only architecture and environmental elements supported by the authentic photo.
Avoid: fantasy architecture, fake ballroom, changed facade, overdramatic HDR, text overlays, UI chrome, borders, watermark, gradients.
source_note: Built-in ImageGen using public/media/shafi-marquee-exterior.jpg and the approved comp crop as references.
